title: Trace bound |trace(P_K ∘ L)| ≤ dim K · ‖L‖ for orthogonal projections (parent step 0.2)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let K be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection P_K = K.starProjection : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, and let L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map. Then |trace(P_K ∘ L)| ≤ (dim K)·‖L‖ (operator norm).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), |LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (K.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ L.toLinearMap)| ≤ (Module.finrank ℝ K : ℝ) * ‖L‖
